Class TextMetrics

java.lang.Object
de.schladebeck.fx.grid.render.TextMetrics
public final class TextMetrics extends Object

Fast text measurement with the same rules the grid uses to cut and wrap text, e.g. for a RowHeightProvider that makes rows as high as their wrapped text:

grid.setRowHeightProvider(row -> {
    Font font = grid.getFont();
    double width = grid.getColumn(NOTES).getWidth() - 2 * grid.getCellPadding();
    return TextMetrics.lineCount(notes(row), font, width) * TextMetrics.lineHeight(font) + 8;
});

The font and sizes are read inside the provider: they come from CSS, which applies only once the grid is in a scene, and they change with the theme. For the JavaFX application thread only.
